principles: Agent prompts are cross-runtime coordination assets and should have one source of truth.
Claude runtime assets must not be copied into Codex when Codex will not execute them.
Verification should fail on missing or stale generated assets before users notice mismatched project trees.
drivers: User saw a concrete mismatch between .claude and .Codex after koala init.
Current README already promises controlled transform behavior.
Future agent additions should not require remembering a second Codex whitelist.

options.name: A: Full mirror agent prompts only
pros: Avoids fake support for Claude hooks/settings/skills
cons: Adds more prompt files to .Codex/agents than before

options.name: B: Keep four-file Codex subset and clarify docs
cons: Does not solve the visible mismatch
Future Koala review agents remain missing from Codex projects

options.name: C: Mirror all .claude assets into .Codex
cons: Creates misleading .Codex/hooks and settings that Codex does not consume
Blurs runtime ownership and may make users expect hooks to run

chosen: A: Full mirror agent prompts only
rationale: Choose full prompt mirroring because it fixes the actual user-visible mismatch while preserving the correct runtime boundary: prompts can be shared, but Claude hooks/settings/skills cannot be made meaningful by copying files.

preMortem.scenario: A new .claude/agents prompt is added later but not generated for Codex
preMortem.trigger: Developer adds a prompt file and forgets Codex assets
preMortem.consequence: Users again see missing .Codex/agents files after koala init
preMortem.mitigation: verify-codex-assets enumerates all .claude/agents/*.md files and fails if Codex is missing one

preMortem.scenario: Codex users expect hooks to run because documentation says assets are mirrored
preMortem.trigger: Docs use ambiguous wording like all assets are mirrored
preMortem.consequence: Users create .Codex/hooks and think tool logging is active when it is not
preMortem.mitigation: Docs explicitly say only agent prompts mirror and hooks/settings/skills remain Claude-only

preMortem.scenario: Old Codex-only prompts remain beside mirrored prompts
preMortem.trigger: Existing repositories have implementer.md or reviewer.md in .Codex/agents
preMortem.consequence: Codex users choose stale prompts with outdated behavior
preMortem.mitigation: verification rejects Codex prompt files that have no .claude source
